segments.sn40.9:1.4: ‘idha bhikkhu sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn40.9:1.6: So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
segments.sn40.9:1.7: Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn40.9:2.1: “Atha kho maṃ, āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca –
segments.sn40.9:2.3: Mā, brāhmaṇa, animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ pamādo, animitte cetosamādhismiṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, animitte cetosamādhismiṃ cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi, animitte cetosamādhismiṃ cittaṃ samādahā’ti.
segments.sn40.9:2.4: So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
segments.sn40.9:2.5: Yañhi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya –
segments.sn40.9:2.6: ‘satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ patto’ti, mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya –

lines: Animittaṃ cetosamādhinti niccanimittādīni pahāya pavattaṃ vipassanāsamādhiṃyeva sandhāyetaṃ vuttanti.
Nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hotīti evaṃ iminā vipassanāsamādhivihārena viharato vipassanāñāṇe tikkhe sūre vahamāne.

Yathā nāma purisassa tikhiṇena pharasunā rukkhaṃ chindantassa “suṭṭhu vata me pharasu vahatī”ti khaṇe khaṇe pharasudhāraṃ olokentassa chejjakiccaṃ na nipphajjati, evaṃ therassāpi “sūraṃ vata me hutvā ñāṇaṃ vahatī”ti vipassanaṃ ārabbha nikanti uppajjati.

Sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja vihāsinti sabbesaṃ niccasukhaattanimittānaṃ amanasikārena animittaṃ vuṭṭhānagāminivipassanāsampayuttaṃ cetosamādhiṃ nibbānārammaṇaṃ uparimaggaphalasamādhiṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
